parameters.query: INSERT INTO automacao_miller.document_processing (source_document_id, source_sha256, source_filename, status, current_stage, attempt_count, started_at, execution_id, markdown_file_id) VALUES ({{ JSON.stringify($("Validate Markdown").item.json.source_document_id) }}, {{ JSON.stringify($("Validate Markdown").item.json.metadata.source_sha256) }}, {{ JSON.stringify($("Validate Markdown").item.json.source_filename) }}, 'em_processamento', 'markdown_persistido', 1, NOW(), {{ JSON.stringify($execution.id) }}, {{ JSON.stringify($json.id || null) }}) ON CONFLICT (source_document_id, source_sha256) DO UPDATE SET status = 'em_processamento', current_stage = 'markdown_persistido', attempt_count = automacao_miller.document_processing.attempt_count + 1, updated_at = NOW(), markdown_file_id = EXCLUDED.markdown_file_id;

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { metadata: { source_filename: $json.source_filename, source_sha256: $json.metadata.source_sha256, page_count: $json.metadata.page_count, converter_version: $json.metadata.converter_version }, analysis: $json.analysis } }];

parameters.query: UPDATE automacao_miller.document_processing SET status = 'concluido', current_stage = 'email_enviado', completed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(), report_file_id = {{ JSON.stringify($('Google Drive - Upload Report').item.json.id) }} WHERE source_document_id = {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate and classify analysis').item.json.source_document_id) }} AND source_sha256 = {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate and classify analysis').item.json.metadata.source_sha256) }};

UPDATE automacao_miller.document_processing SET status = 'aguardando_revisao', current_stage = 'revisao_humana', updated_at = NOW(), error_category = 'validacao' WHERE source_document_id = {{ JSON.stringify($json.source_document_id) }} AND source_sha256 = {{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata.source_sha256) }};

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM automacao_miller.document_processing WHERE source_document_id = {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate Markdown').item.json.source_document_id) }} AND source_sha256 = {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate Markdown').item.json.metadata.source_sha256) }} AND status = 'concluido') AS already_processed;
